actualCorrectionReceipt.method: Independent unmodified-prop tracking. Original RGBA details are projected directly, or first combined with the same fully visible native frame-zero inert prop and then tracked as a complete template. One CRF16 encode from the unchanged raw source.
actualCorrectionReceipt.scope: Explicit per-region masks may include the full inert prop, outline and nearby background feather when an inertSourcePolygon is provided. Otherwise masks may include fringe, cheeks, nose, mouth or chin. Whole-frame lossy re-encoding. No person covered or removed.
actualCorrectionReceipt.lightingScope: Explicit scene-calibrated RGB gain and bounded reference-space softening. Raw video remains the base; no global grade, human anatomy patch or duration change.

outsideComparison.meaning: Lossy encode comparison outside print; not pixel identity or automatic semantic approval.
